problem.title: Design Undo Redo Editor
problem.problemStatement: Design a text editor that supports the following operations: type(text) — Append text to the document. undo() — Undo the most recent typing operation. redo() — Reapply the most recently undone operation. print() — Print the current document. Implement the editor efficiently using a linked-list-based history mechanism. Process all operations and print the document for every print() operation.
problem.output: Print the current document after every print() operation.
problem.constraints: 1 <= q <= 2 × 10^5 Total length of all inserted text does not exceed 10^6
